BUILD-AHEAD TO RESET | G3 allocation -> G5 moves -> G6 evidence
Sequence records timing; it does not establish causation.
|
+-- [S] 2021: reinvest gross profit and accelerate hiring.
|   `-- [S] 2022 plan: more engineers than 2021; $200M planned capex.
+-- [S] GMV growth: Q1 2021 114% -> Q1 2022 16% -> Q2 2022 11%.
|   `-- [S] Management cited stimulus comparisons and spending shifts.
+-- [R] July 2022: workforce reduced about 10%; Deliverr acquired.
|   `-- [I] Acquisition and retrenchment overlapped.
+-- [S] Sept 2022: Flex Comp launched; staff choose cash/equity split.
|   `-- [S] Higher compensation costs, mainly R&D; cash share increased.
+-- [S] Late April 2023: standard price rise for existing merchants.
|   `-- [S] Largest absolute contributor to Q2 MRR growth.
+-- [R] May 2023: workforce reduced about 23% in annual filing.
|   `-- [S] Call's about 20% excluded logistics employees.
+-- [R] June 6, 2023: majority of logistics businesses sold to Flexport.
|   +-- [R] FY23 logistics impairment $1.34B; operating loss $1.42B.
|   `-- [I] Impairment distorts comparison with ongoing operating costs.
`-- [S] Q4 2023: $260M Flexport convertible-note investment.
    `-- [I] Logistics ownership exit retained a financial partnership.
